facts.raw_span: A man in his 40s presented with a new pigmented lesion on his left second toenail
The lesion first appeared 12 months before presentation and was progressively growing
The lesion was asymptomatic
He was otherwise well and denied any fevers or weight loss
dark brown longitudinal pigment band covering the full length of the toenail of the left second digit with corresponding nail thickening over the pigmented band
The pigment was the same width throughout the band and extended to the proximal nail fold
No other nail or skin lesions were found at the time of examination
Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
No melanocytic lesions observed
Immunostaining negative for S100 and CD34
Intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis present
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia

concepts.why: The presence of bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix, absence of melanocytic lesions, and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate are characteristic of onychopapilloma.
The dark brown longitudinal pigment band and corresponding nail thickening, along with bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix, are consistent with onychomatricoma.

Although the histopathologic examination did not show melanocytic lesions, the clinical presentation of a dark brown longitudinal pigment band could be suggestive of a nail unit melanocytoma, but this is less likely given the absence of melanocytic lesions.
It explains the finding of intracorneal hemorrhage and adjacent verrucous hyperkeratosis present in the histopathologic examination.
It explains the finding of bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium and negative immunostaining for S100 and CD34.

rationales.F05: Pigmented band is a common feature of onychopapilloma and onychomatricoma, but less common in nail unit melanocytoma
rationales.F08: Bland spindle cell proliferation is a characteristic feature of onychopapilloma and onychomatricoma
rationales.F09: Absence of melanocytic lesions rules out nail unit melanocytoma
rationales.F12: Villous fibroepithelial projections are a characteristic feature of onychopapilloma and onychomatricoma

frontier_selector.rationale: Onychomatricoma best explains the combination of dark brown longitudinal pigment band, nail thickening, and bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium.
